findings.description: Responsiveness ACs did not define p95/p99/max latency or timeout thresholds.
findings.suggested_action: Add objective responsiveness thresholds for status/cancel IPC and event-loop heartbeat.

findings.description: Worker/native packaged-runtime validation was under-specified; OPS-ARCH-010 covered main-process lazy load but not worker/child runtime load.
findings.suggested_action: Require worker/child package smoke for better-sqlite3 and optional HNSW native load/degraded state.

findings.description: Semantic/HNSW maintenance responsiveness could be tested only through keyword rebuild/compact.
findings.suggested_action: Explicitly include semantic embedding reindex and HNSW build/compact in responsiveness criteria.

findings.description: WAL-safe backup guidance was directionally correct but lacked concrete safe paths.
findings.suggested_action: Require SQLite backup API, checkpoint plus DB/WAL/SHM capture, or explicit user skip in redacted manifest.

findings.description: Tokenizer bounding lacked default/maximum bound and large single-file behavior.
findings.suggested_action: Reference default maxAnalysisChars 1200 and 160 MiB single-file fixture behavior.

findings.description: Trace links missed FR-DOC-023, FR-DOC-024, and FR-DOC-025.
findings.suggested_action: Add tokenizer, embedding/HNSW lifecycle, and smart_search fallback traces.

findings.description: Settings addition-site trace omitted button handlers around L631-L649.

resolution.post_resolution_validation: mcp__speckiwi.validate_spec strict returned 0 errors and 0 warnings after index summary sync.
